## Load data

```{r}
zotu97 <- import_qiime("01_Raw_data/p1031_run231023_ITS_ccs_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")

metadata <- read.csv("01_Raw_data/metadata_2025.csv" ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var= "sample_name")
metadata$treat.pot <- paste(metadata$treatment, metadata$rep, sep= "_")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))



##modifiyin the table to change rowxcol
otu_mat <- otu_table(`zotu97`)
if (taxa_are_rows(`zotu97`)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)          
}
#filtering
otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_mat)
min_reads <- 3       
min_samples <- 3     
prevalence <- colSums(otu_mat >= min_reads)
keep_otus <- prevalence >= min_samples

otu_filt <- otu_mat[, keep_otus, drop = FALSE]
cat("ZOTUs kept:", ncol(otu_filt), "out of", ncol(otu_mat), "\n")
#ZOTUs kept: 739 out of 1641 

zotu_filt <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(otu_filt, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  sample_data(sample_data(zotu97)),      # 
  tax_table(tax_table(zotu97)[keep_otus, ])
)
zotu_filt
```

## CLR transform and data preparation

```{r}
# PCA exploring
##phyloseq filter (zotu_filt)
otu_filt
# Normalization clr
otu_clr <- decostand(otu_filt, method = "clr", pseudocount = 1)  

pca_clr <- prcomp(otu_clr, scale. = TRUE, center=TRUE) 
var_perc_clr <- (pca_clr$sdev^2 / sum(pca_clr$sdev^2)) * 100
scores_clr <- pca_clr$x


meta <- as(sample_data(zotu_filt), "data.frame")
## scores 
scores_clr <- as.data.frame(pca_clr$x)
scores_clr$sample_id <- rownames(scores_clr)

meta$treatment <- factor(meta$treatment)
meta$time      <- factor(meta$time)
meta$treat.pot <- factor(meta$treat.pot)

```

## Euclidean distances

```{r}
eu_distances_all <- vegdist(otu_clr, method = "euclidean")

##permutations
set.seed(123)
meta <- meta[attr(eu_distances_all, "Labels"), , drop = FALSE]
#meta to data frame
head(meta)

eu_permanova_all <- adonis2(
  eu_distances_all ~ treatment * time,
  data     = meta,
  strata   = meta$treat.pot,
  by       = "terms",
  permutations = 999
)

meta$sample_id <- rownames(meta)
plot_df_clr <- left_join(scores_clr, meta, by = "sample_id")


plot_df_clr <- plot_df_clr %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = treat.order))
rowSums(otu_clr)


perm_all <- paste("PERMANOVA",
  paste0("Treat: R²=", round(eu_permanova_all["treatment","R2"],2),
         ", F=", round(eu_permanova_all["treatment","F"],2),
         ", p=", signif(eu_permanova_all["treatment","Pr(>F)"],2)),
  paste0("Time: R²=", round(eu_permanova_all["time","R2"],2),
         ", F=", round(eu_permanova_all["time","F"],2),
         ", p=", signif(eu_permanova_all["time","Pr(>F)"],2)),
  paste0("Treat×Time: R²=", round(eu_permanova_all["treatment:time","R2"],2),
         ", F=", round(eu_permanova_all["treatment:time","F"],2),
         ", p=", signif(eu_permanova_all["treatment:time","Pr(>F)"],2)),
  sep="\n"
)

p_pca_clr <- ggplot(plot_df_clr, aes(PC1, PC2, color = treatment, shape = time)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treat.colors, breaks = treat.order, labels = treat.labels) +
  labs(
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", var_perc_clr[1]),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", var_perc_clr[2]),
    title = "PCA", color = "Treatment",
    shape = "Time"
  ) +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))+
    geom_text(
  aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = perm_all),
  hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
  size = 3,
  color = "black"
)

p_pca_clr

ggsave(p_pca_clr, file= "04_Figures/Supplemetary_FigureS5_ITS.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(p_pca_clr, file = '03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplemetary_FigureS5_ITS.rds')

```

## RDA with soil properties

```{r}
#load data
soil_data<- readxl::read_excel("01_Raw_data/metadata_2025_soil.xlsx")
#normalizada con clr
otu_clr 

#no selectec cfu, ni respiration
env_data <- soil_data %>%
  dplyr::select(org.matter, phosphorus, MOT,
         calcium, magnesium, sodium, potassium, ph.water,
         pH.chloride, conductivity, nitrogen)

rda_full <- rda(otu_clr ~ ., data = env_data)
summary(rda_full)
vif.cca(rda_full) 

env_data_reduced <- env_data %>%
  dplyr::select(-pH.chloride)

rda_reduced <- rda(otu_clr ~ ., data = env_data_reduced)
summary(rda_reduced)
vif.cca(rda_reduced)
#to fix the r2
rda_null <- rda(otu_clr ~ 1, data = env_data_reduced) 
set.seed(123)

rda_step <- ordiR2step(rda_null,
                       scope = formula(rda_reduced),
                       direction = "forward", 
                       R2scope = TRUE,
                       pstep = 999) 


step_df <- as.data.frame(rda_step$anova)
step_df
rownames(step_df)

summary(rda_step)
```

## Stats RDA 

```{r}
#stadstics
global_test<-anova(rda_step, permutations = 99) # global test
axis_test<-anova(rda_step, by = "axis", permutations = 99) # axis RDA
variable_test<-anova(rda_step, by = "terms", permutations = 99)
RsquareAdj(rda_step)


F_value <- round(global_test$F[1], 2)
p_value <- global_test$`Pr(>F)`[1]

p_label <- ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "< 0.001", round(p_value, 3))
subtitle_text <- paste0(
  "Global test: F = ", F_value, ", p ", p_label,
  " | Adj. R² = ", round(RsquareAdj(rda_step)$adj.r.squared, 3)
)

treat <- soil_data$treatment
time  <- soil_data$time
identical(soil_data$sample_id, rownames(otu_clr))

scal <- 2
sc <- scores(rda_step, display = c("sites","bp"), scaling = scal)
sites <- as.data.frame(sc$sites)
sites$sample_id <- rownames(sites)
sites$treatment <- soil_data$treatment
sites$time <- soil_data$time

arrows <- as.data.frame(sc$biplot)
arrows$var <- rownames(arrows)

#Constrained variance
imp <- summary(rda_step, scaling = scal)$cont$importance

rda1_perc <- round(100 * rda_step$CCA$eig[1] / rda_step$CCA$tot.chi, 1)
rda2_perc <- round(100 * rda_step$CCA$eig[2] / rda_step$CCA$tot.chi, 1)

arrow_mul <- ordiArrowMul(rda_step, display = "bp", scaling = scal)
booster <- 5
arrows2 <- arrows
arrows2$RDA1 <- arrows$RDA1 * arrow_mul*booster
arrows2$RDA2 <- arrows$RDA2 * arrow_mul*booster


arrows2$len <- sqrt(arrows2$RDA1^2 + arrows2$RDA2^2)
offset <- 1
arrows2$hoffset <- ifelse(arrows2$len > 0, arrows2$RDA1 / arrows2$len * offset, 0)
arrows2$RDA1_label <-  arrows2$RDA1+ c(0.2, -0.3, 0.4,-0.4, 0.2, -0.4, 0.2,-0.1,0,0)
arrows2$voffset <- ifelse(arrows2$len > 0, arrows2$RDA2 / arrows2$len * offset, 1)



label_boost <- 2.5  


rda_alldata <- ggplot(sites, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2,
                        color = factor(treatment),
                        shape = factor(time))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treat.colors,
                     breaks = treat.order,
                     labels = treat.labels,
                     name   = "Treatment") +
  geom_segment(data = arrows2,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25,"cm"))) +
  geom_text(
  data = arrows2,
  aes(x = RDA1_label ,
      y = RDA2 ,
      label = var),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 4,
  color = "gray10") +
  labs(x = paste0("RDA1 (", rda1_perc, "%)"),
       y = paste0("RDA2 (", rda2_perc, "%)"),
       color = "Treatment", shape = "Time",
       title = "RDA-Soil properties") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")+
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = subtitle_text,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
    size = 4, 
  )


rda_alldata
ggsave(rda_alldata, file= "04_Figures/Fig2_ITS.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(rda_alldata, file = '03_Analysis_files/Fig2_ITS.rds')


```

## RDA with plant parameters

```{r}

#load data
plant_data<- readxl::read_excel("01_Raw_data/plant_data.xlsx")

meta <- as(sample_data(zotu_filt), "data.frame")
meta$sample_id <- rownames(meta)
#only last time point
idx_T5       <- meta$time == "T5"
otu_clr_T5   <- otu_clr[idx_T5, , drop = FALSE]
meta_T5      <- meta[idx_T5, c("sample_id","time","treatment","rep")]
samples_T5   <- rownames(otu_clr_T5)

plant_T5 <- plant_data %>%
  filter(time == "T5") %>%
  left_join(meta_T5, by = c("time","treatment","rep"))

# check
stopifnot(!any(is.na(plant_T5$sample_id)))

env_data_plant <- plant_T5%>%
  dplyr::select(pseudostem, heigh, root_length, root_kg, leaves, area_foliar_m2, nitrogen, phosphorus, calcium , magnesium, sodium , potassium)
rda_full_plant <- rda(otu_clr_T5 ~ ., data = env_data_plant)

#envfit 
ef_T5 <- envfit(rda_full_plant, env_data_plant, permutations = 999)
ef_T5

```

## Stats RDA 

```{r}
#stadstics
global_test_plant<-anova(rda_full_plant, permutations = 99) 
axis_test_plant<-anova(rda_full_plant, by = "axis", permutations = 99) 
variable_test_plant<-anova(rda_full_plant, by = "terms", permutations = 99)  

RsquareAdj(rda_full_plant)


F_valueplant <- round(global_test_plant$F[1], 2)
p_valueplant <- global_test_plant$`Pr(>F)`[1]

p_label_plant <- ifelse(p_valueplant < 0.001, "< 0.001", round(p_valueplant, 3))
subtitle_text_plant <- paste0(
  "Global test: F = ", F_valueplant, ", p = ", p_label_plant,
  " | Adj. R² = ", round(RsquareAdj(rda_full_plant)$adj.r.squared, 3)
)


scal <- 2
sc_plant <- scores(rda_full_plant, display = c("sites","bp"), scaling = scal)
sites_plant <- as.data.frame(sc_plant$sites)
sites_plant$sample_id <- rownames(sites_plant)
sites_plant$treatment <- plant_T5$treatment
sites_plant$time <- plant_T5$time

arrows_plant <- as.data.frame(sc_plant$biplot)
arrows_plant$var <- rownames(arrows_plant)

imp_plant <- summary(rda_full_plant, scaling = scal)$cont$importance


rda1_perc <- round(100 * rda_full_plant$CCA$eig[1] / rda_full_plant$CCA$tot.chi, 1)
rda2_perc <- round(100 * rda_full_plant$CCA$eig[2] / rda_full_plant$CCA$tot.chi, 1)

names(arrows_plant)

mult <-5
arrows2_plant <- transform(arrows_plant, RDA1 = RDA1 * mult, RDA2 = RDA2 * mult)
names(arrows2_plant)
head(arrows2_plant)

rda_alldata_plant <- ggplot(sites_plant, aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2,
                        color = factor(treatment))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treat.colors,
                     breaks = treat.order,
                     labels = treat.labels,
                     name   = "Treatment") +
  geom_segment(data = arrows2_plant,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.18,"cm"))) +
  geom_text_repel(
  data = arrows2_plant,
  aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, label = var),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 4,
  color = "gray10",
  box.padding   = 0.35,   # espacio alrededor del texto (más = más separación)
  point.padding = 0.25,   # separación respecto al extremo de la flecha
  force         = 2,      # empuje (sube si sigue muy junto)
  max.overlaps  = Inf
)+
  labs(x = paste0("RDA1 (", rda1_perc, "%)"),
       y = paste0("RDA2 (", rda2_perc, "%)"),
       color = "Treatment",
       title = "RDA Plant") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right")+
   annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = subtitle_text_plant,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
    size = 4, 
  )

rda_alldata_plant
ggsave(rda_alldata_plant, file= "04_Figures/Supplemetary_FigureS6_ITS.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(rda_alldata_plant, file = '03_Analysis_files//Supplementary_plot/Supplemetary_FigureS6_ITS.rds')


```
